name: repo-tom.quest
note: Whether a run with no tom.quest checkout open reaches for its rules, and whether a run standing inside tom.quest leaves the skill alone because the CLI has already loaded AGENTS.md.

cases.prompt: You are working in ComplexMultiTrigger. Tom asks how a change reaches tom.Quest's production site. Answer him.
cases.why: the deploy is one line of another repository's rules, and a run with no checkout of it open has nowhere else to read that line

cases.prompt: From a session with no tom.quest checkout, say which checks have to be green before one of its branches may merge.
cases.why: the merge bar is named in that repository's rules and nowhere else, so an answer assembled from the workflow names would list the wrong set

cases.prompt: A session in the vault is writing about tom.Quest's account model. Name the roles above `user`.
cases.why: the roles are a fact of that repository, and a run outside it either loads them or invents them

cases.prompt: You are in the tom.quest checkout, adding a quest route. Say what to change.
cases.why: a run standing inside tom.quest has already been given AGENTS.md by the CLI, so the skill must stay silent rather than carry a second copy of it into the prompt

cases.prompt: Say what `cmt/methods/AGENTS.md` is the operating knowledge for.
cases.why: a question about another repository's rules is answered out of that repository, and tom.Quest's stack is not part of the answer

cases.prompt: Write the commit message for a change under the vault's model-of-tom/.
cases.why: a commit in another repository takes none of tom.Quest's deployment or verification rules
